# Sound — thecatcourt, Film 01: *The State v. The Cat*

**TL;DR** — One score file, `public/audio/thecatcourt-01.mp3`, generated by
`scripts/generate-score.sh`. 22.000s, 120 BPM, 44 beats. 43 SFX events + 1 silent beat.
Beat `n` = `n * 0.5s` = frame `30n` at 60 fps. Placement is taken verbatim from the SFX
column of `docs/shotlist.md` §3.
**Verified against:** `scripts/generate-score.sh` @ 2026-10-04, ffmpeg n9.0.1.
**Delivered:** -13.8 LUFS integrated, -1.3 dBFS true peak, 22.000s, 192 kbps mp3.

Everything is synthesised in ffmpeg `lavfi` — no samples, no licensing. Every noise source is
seeded, so the file is byte-reproducible.

---

## 1. Timing contract for scene builders

| | |
|---|---|
| Beat length | 0.5s / 30 frames |
| Bar length | 2.0s / 120 frames / 4 beats |
| Total | 11 bars / 44 beats / 1320 frames / 22.000s |
| Beat `n` starts at | `n * 0.5` seconds, `n * 30` frames |

**A sound's perceived hit lands on its beat, not its file start.** Three stems are pre-delayed
so their peak (not their onset) sits on the grid:

| Stem | File offset | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `whoosh` | starts 400ms **before** the beat | 0.70s swell peaking at 0.40s |
| `drop` | starts 400ms **before** the beat | 0.42s downward glide, landing impact at 0.40s |
| `riser` | starts 1000ms **before** the beat | 1.5s build whose peak lands one beat **after** its listed beat — it builds *under* beat 14 and resolves on the beat-15 slam; builds under beat 31 and resolves on the beat-32 verdict wipe |

All other stems (`thump`, `slam`, `click`, `tick`, `stamp`) are transient-first: file start = beat.

## 3. The musical bed — arc per bar

The bed is independent of the SFX layer. Three kick stems carry the pulse; an off-eighth hat
layer (the `tick` one-shot at -14 dB, weight 0.35) carries the texture; a 65.41 Hz drone
(`sub`) and a six-voice C minor pad carry the harmony. Section envelopes are evaluated
per frame with 50–200ms ramps so no step ever clicks.

| Bar | Beats | Time | What the bed does |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0–3 | 0.0–2.0 | Sparse. Soft kicks on 0 and 2 only. Drone at 0.30, pad silent. The hook is carried by the three slams, not by music. |
| 1 | 4–7 | 2.0–4.0 | Mechanical. Mid kicks on every beat, off-eighth hats start. Drone steps to 0.48 and the pad whispers in at t=2.0s. |
| 2 | 8–11 | 4.0–6.0 | Same mechanical pulse, pad grows at t=6.0s boundary. The charge accumulates. |
| 3 | 12–15 | 6.0–8.0 | Accumulating. Drone at 0.62 (step at t=6.0s). Riser at 14 pushes into the Exhibit A claim. |
| 4 | 16–19 | 8.0–10.0 | Pad +0.08 at t=8.0s. Kicks on every beat. |
| 5 | 20–23 | 10.0–12.0 | Densest pre-verdict bar: pad +0.06 at t=10.0s, kicks subdivide to eighths from beat 21.5. Builds straight into the floor drop. |
| 6 | 24–27 | 12.0–14.0 | **Floor drops.** At t=11.9s the drone loses 0.62 and the pad 0.34; kicks and hats stop entirely. The deliberation runs ~20 dB below everything around it — bare SFX over near-silence. |
| 7 | 28–31 | 14.0–16.0 | Still bare. The beat-28 stamp is the only loud event. Riser at 31 builds the section back up. |
| 8 | 32–35 | 16.0–18.0 | **Biggest.** At t=15.95s the drone jumps +0.85 and the pad +0.40 in a 50ms ramp. Hard kicks on every beat plus eighths at 35.5. The beat-35 stamp sits on top of it. |
| 9 | 36–39 | 18.0–20.0 | Holds at full. Hard kicks continue through 39.5. |
| 10 | 40–43 | 20.0–22.0 | Resolve. Drone -0.35 at t=19.95s, pad -0.15 at t=20.0s, then both decay from t=21.5–21.6s. Soft kicks only. A 150ms fade from t=21.85s takes the file to the loop point. |

---

## 4. Loudness chain — do not simplify

Three stages, in this order. Each exists because the stage after it measurably shifts the result.

1. **Limiter** (`alimiter=limit=0.891`, -1.0 dBFS) on the summed mix. The mix is extremely
   peaky — a stamp over a near-silent bed — so this squashes the peak-to-loudness ratio before
   normalisation sees it.
2. **Two-pass `loudnorm`** to `I=-14:TP=-2.6:LRA=11`, `linear=true`, with the pass-1 JSON
   measurements fed into pass 2.
3. **Delivered-format residual trim.** `libmp3lame` shifts integrated loudness by ~0.8 LU and
   overshoots the PCM true peak by ~1 dB. The script encodes a probe mp3, measures *that*,
   computes the residual, and re-encodes from the normalised PCM with the trim folded in — so
   the delivered file is measured, not assumed, and only one lossy generation is ever used.

The `TP=-2.6` target is not arbitrary: -2.6 plus the ~0.86 dB residual trim plus the ~1 dB mp3
overshoot lands at -1.3 dBFS delivered. Raising it to -2.0 pushes the delivered file to exactly
-1.0 with no margin.

## 5. Regenerating

```bash
bash scripts/generate-score.sh            # ~2s, writes public/audio/thecatcourt-01.mp3
ffmpeg -i public/audio/thecatcourt-01.mp3 -af ebur128=peak=true -f null -   # verify
```

Spec: integrated within 0.5 LU of -14.0, true peak at or below -1.0 dBFS, duration 22.000s.
`PRE_GAIN` is exposed as an env var (default 1.0) to drive the limiter harder if the mix ever
gets peakier than the budget allows.

> **Do not touch** `scripts/generate-bg-music.sh` / `public/audio/background.mp3`. That is the
> Remotion cat-facts bed and is unrelated to this film.
